text: PAGID Racing is the exclusive motorsport brand of the TMD Friction Group; PAGID Racing's own site says TMD Friction owns 100% of PAGID Racing.
short: PAGID Racing is the motorsport brand of TMD Friction, which owns it 100%.

source.name: PAGID Racing: About PAGID Racing
source.quote: PAGID Racing is the exclusive motorsport brand of the TMD Friction Group, producing racing and high performance brake pads.
